body: CORRECTION to the earlier month-picker crash entry (01M3GSCDD6B59SKBRYZ4FFZBEK): the crash is a probe artefact, not a user-facing defect.U+000AU+000AU+002D Probe with the accessibility switch: 6 of 6 closes crashed (SIGSEGV in AccessibilityBridge::CreateRemoveReparentedNodesUpdate), including a 6th run at 01:08:53. In the same probe, macOS's live AX tree holds only the window buttons: no Flutter content is attached even though the engine bridge commits updates.U+000AU+002D Stock Flutter app (flutter create axstock, same env-gated notification, same ax_dump): full AX tree exposed. So the switch and the reader work.U+000AU+002D Real app (plain build at d36b748, bundle renamed to dev.satanshumishra.fieldNotes.plain, plus the same env-gated switch, launched with `open -g --env PROBE_AX=1`): full AX tree exposed (sidebar, buttons, texts, calendar days). Month picker opened by an AX press, then Escape delivered to the app's pid only (pinp U+003Cpid> key 53, app frontmost after 20 s owner idle): no crash, 2 of 2; the picker closed (m1_plain_after_escape_ax_on.png).U+000AU+002D Conclusion: the probe's wrapping of FieldNotesApp leaves the macOS accessibility root unattached, and the engine crashes on reparent-removal in that state. Probe-only; worth fixing in the harness because it blocks accessibility work in the probe.U+000AU+000AReal finding that stands (macOS counterpart of the Android month-picker gap), Hurts or Blocks for VoiceOver users:U+000AU+002D With accessibility on, the open month picker is absent from macOS's AX tree: no Jan to Dec, no year arrows, no "Back to this week", no "Dismiss month picker", while the calendar grid behind it stays exposed (BlockSemantics has no effect in the live tree). Pressing "Jump to a month" again through AX does not close it, and pressing a grid day behind it does nothing, so a VoiceOver user who opens it can only leave with Escape. Evidence: ax_plain_picker_open.txt, m1_plain_picker_open_ax_on.png, m1_plain_picker_toggled_closed.png, m1_plain_picker_day20_press.png.U+000AU+002D Method caveat: VoiceOver itself was not turned on (system setting); the switch posts the notification VoiceOver's AXEnhancedUserInterface causes.
